description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 17

tasks.reason: Java 17 is a Long-Term Support (LTS) release with significant language improvements, new APIs, and performance enhancements over older versions.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 17. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 17. Address any deprecated or removed APIs. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 17.
